in_greek.name: Θεόφιλος
in_greek.long_meaning: Δεοπιλοσ πλεω δηυ δεω γερστερνες θερώγμόυα τεμσρα κρητες. Δεοπιλοσ βγρθς τε τεργνοό τώγερϊδες, ηερϊτέρέτη δηυ κρητες.

in_latin.name: Theophilos
in_latin.meaning: Amicus Dei, Deus amicus, amicus divinus
in_latin.long_meaning: Theophilos est nomen, quod significat amicum Dei, Deum amicum, amicum divinum. Nomen hoc derivatum est a duobus verbis Graecis, Δεοπιλοσ et τωσ, quae significat Deus. Theophilos in Novo Testamento apparuit in Actis Apostolorum 6:5 et 6:8, ubi nomen hic significat amicorum Dei. In historia ecclesiastica, Theophilos fuit unus ex primis missionariis Christi, qui evangelium evangelizavit in Asia Minor.

in_english.name: Theophilos
in_english.meaning: Friend of God, God's friend, divine friend
in_english.long_meaning: Theophilos is a name that means friend of God, God's friend, divine friend. Derived from the Greek words Δεοπιλοσ (Theophilos) and τωσ (Theos), which mean God, Theophilos in the New Testament appeared in Acts of the Apostles 6:5 and 6:8, where this name signifies friends of God. In Christian history, Theophilos was one of the first missionaries of Christ, who evangelized the gospel in Asia Minor.

biblical_reference.note: In Acts of the Apostles, Theophilos was one of the seven deacons chosen by the apostles to serve the early Christian community in Jerusalem.
